approvals.label: Approval workflows

geo_fix_proposals.label: GEO fix proposals

experiments.label: Proof Engine experiments
experiments.pitch: Test one change on half your pages and prove what moves rankings and citations.

competitors.label: Competitor tracking

market_brain.label: Market Brain

audience.label: Audience
audience.pitch: See how your audience is likely to react before you post, and learn from what really happened.

analytics_insights.label: GA4 and Search Console insights

publishing.label: Publishing
publishing.pitch: Publish and schedule to every social network with unlimited posts, plus WordPress and Webflow. Publishing never uses credits.

backlinks.label: Backlink marketplace
backlinks.pitch: Buy real placements on relevant sites, verified live on the page.

client_portal.label: Client portal
client_portal.pitch: Share work with clients and collect feedback without giving them a seat.

command_center.label: Agency command center
command_center.pitch: Every client brand's health, tasks and results on one screen.

autopilot.label: Autopilot
autopilot.pitch: Mellox plans, writes and schedules your marketing. You approve before anything goes out.

white_label.label: White-label
white_label.pitch: Your agency's name, logo and colours on the client portal and shared reports.
